title: An SPH model with physically prescribed parameters for droplet dynamics on complex surfaces
summary: Numerical simulation of droplet dynamics on complex surfaces with varying wettability is of great significance to both engineering applications and fundamental research. However, existing numerical methods still face challenges in accurately capturing interfacial interactions while preserving physical consistency and computational efficiency. In this work, a physically grounded and efficient smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH) model is developed for droplet dynamics simulation.
